facts.fact: NIMC and the government say NIN verification is in use, for example facilitating student loans through NIN verification since May 2024.
NIMC says NIN data is linked with 125 partner agencies and the NIN is used for student loans, SIM linkage and other services.
President Tinubu said NIMC had harmonised and linked data with 125 partner agencies, including the National Population Commission for birth registration.

NGA.note: Only says NIN enables business registration; no register stated.
Nothing on a digital civil register.
The BATTIC data centre supports border and passport services only, not for hire.
Disability policy trained ID enrolment agents; no information or digital service accessibility stated.
No government payment to people stated.
126 million enrolled is stated but no population figure or share, so no rung settled.
Nothing on who operates or owns the platform.

facts.fact: President Tinubu said NIMC had linked data with 125 partner agencies, including the Federal Inland Revenue Service for tax records.
President Tinubu said over 126 million Nigerians are enrolled in the National Identity Database, with capacity raised from 100 million to 250 million records.
NIMC's director-general said NIN verification facilitated student loans for over 449,000 students since May 2024, and the NIN-SIM linkage is enforced with the NCC.
The document names NIN use in telecoms (SIM linkage), education loans (NELFUND), agriculture programmes and health insurance enrolment.
NIMC reports 449,000 students benefited from loans via NIN verification (N86.35 billion disbursed) and data linked with 125 partner agencies.

NGA.note: No data centre for hire stated.

facts.fact: President Tinubu said special exercises were conducted to enrol refugees and internally displaced persons in the national identity database.

NGA.note: Says NIN improves tax collection; no electronic payment stated.
